nodes.remediation: Give the token's account Administer Jira, or Administer Projects on every project to sync (the Administrator role in team-managed projects). Scoped API token: the `read:jira-user` and `manage:jira-configuration` scopes.
Grant Browse Projects to users, groups or project roles. Onyx cannot map Reporter, Assignee, Project Lead or user-field grants, so those users get no access in Onyx.

Give the token's account Administer Jira, or Administer Projects on every project to sync (the Administrator role in team-managed projects). Scoped API token: the `read:jira-user` and `manage:jira-configuration` scopes.

Make user emails visible to the token's account. Cloud: Atlassian returns a user's email only when the user's profile shows it (Profile and visibility > Contact), or when the organization makes emails visible to apps. Users without a visible email get no access in Onyx. Data Center: Jira Data Center returns emails only when 'User email visibility' (General configuration) is 'Public', or 'Only visible to logged-in users' with a token account that can see them.

Give the token's account Administer Jira, or the global Browse users and groups permission. On Data Center the account must be in a Jira administrators group. Scoped API token: the `read:jira-user` and `manage:jira-configuration` scopes.
Group sync skips the groups after the limit, so their members lose access in Onyx. A Jira administrator can raise the jira.ajax.autocomplete.limit setting (Data Center).
